newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures close shortened session higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures close shortened session higher.

text.p: U.S. debt futures closed higher, with March T-bonds making another run towards the 114-00 level before closing early ahead of the three-day holiday weekend in the U.S.
Bond futures closed at 1210 CST/1810 GMT and Eurodollar futures ended at 1200 CST/1800 GMT. U.S. markets will be closed on Monday, February 17 for U.S. Presidents' Day.
Trade for bond futures will resume on Tuesday in a larger trading pit as the CBOT opens its new trading facility.
"It could be interesting," a clerk said. "I'll be looking at a broker at a different angle and four times farther away."
He and other floor sources also noted that the opening of the larger CBOT financial trading floor will coincide with ever-expanding open interest in bond futures.

Total bond futures open interest set a record of 560,280 on Thursday, up 17,950 from Wednesday, according to the CBOT. Eight of the 10 highest open interest levels recorded at the CBOT have been set in the last two weeks.
Several traders were surprised March T-bonds retested 113-31/32 for a second time without a substantial selloff.
"I'm amazed," one trader said. "I'm waiting for the other shoe to drop."

March T-bonds immediately retested 113-31/32 after the Federal Reserve's $1.125 billion coupon pass. One market analyst said the Fed's coupon pass was executed one to two months earlier than usual because there was no coupon pass in late November.
Front-month Eurodollars found decent buyers, which continued to narrow the calendar spreads below 50 basis points. The September spread narrowed to 46 bps.
"The curve continues to flatten because the front months have been holding in better than expected," one Eurodollar futures trader said.

At the end of pit trade, March T-bonds were up 19/32 at 113-30/32, 10-year notes were up 11/32 at 110-09/32, June T-bills were up three basis points at 94.96, and June and September Eurodollars were each up three bps at 94.41 and 94.31.
